dialog.checkouts.title: Checkouts
dialog.checkouts.desc1: git checkout <target>      Switch to branch, tag, or commit

dialog.checkouts.desc3: Supports: local branch, origin/branch, tag, commit hash

dialog.danger.no_ask: Do not ask again for 1 minute
dialog.merge.title: Merge Branch
dialog.merge.general_desc: Merge commits from the specified branch into the current branch
dialog.merge.desc1: git merge <branch>              Git decides merge strategy
dialog.merge.desc2: git merge --no-ff <branch>      Force a merge commit
dialog.merge.desc3: git merge --squash <branch>     Squash commits, manual commit needed
dialog.merge.desc4: git merge --ff-only <branch>    Fast-forward only; fails otherwise
dialog.merge.branch_hint: Merge operation will merge into this branch
dialog.merge.source_hint: Enter or select the source branch to merge in
dialog.merge.source_hint2: Branch to merge in (merges into current branch)
dialog.merge.mode_default_hint: Git decides: fast-forward if possible, else merge commit
dialog.merge.mode_noff_hint: Keeps branch history, recommended for feature -> main
dialog.merge.mode_squash_hint: Squash into one, manual commit required
dialog.merge.mode_ffonly_hint: Fails if FF not possible, strict linear history
dialog.merge.switch_missing: Source branch field is empty. Please fill it in first.
dialog.merge.incomplete_msg: Please select a source branch or enter a commit hash!
dialog.rebase_onto.title: Rebase --onto
dialog.rebase_onto.desc2: Moves commits after <upstream> (exclusive) up to <branch> onto <newbase>
dialog.rebase_onto.desc3: Example: Move last 3 commits of feature onto main -> newbase=main, upstream=HEAD~3
dialog.rebase_onto.branch_hint: Rebase applies to this branch (or the Branch field below)
dialog.rebase_onto.newbase_hint: Where commits should land (target base), e.g. main, dev, hash
dialog.rebase_onto.upstream_hint: Start point (exclusive): commits after this will be moved, e.g. HEAD~3
dialog.rebase_onto.missing_msg: New Base and Upstream are required fields!
dialog.rebase_onto.switch_field_empty: Branch field is empty. Please fill it in first.
